# THE COASTAL AQUACULTURE AUTHORITY ACT, 2005

 ACT NO. 24 OF 2005

[23rd June, 2005.]

# An Act to provide for the establishment of a Coastal Aquaculture Authority for regulating the
 activities connected with coastal aquaculture in the coastal areas and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

BE it enacted by Parliament in the Fifty-sixth Year of the Republic of India as follows:—

CHAPTER I

PRELIMINARY
